# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (Aug 5, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Today, development focused on addressing a flaky test and closing an issue related to opgeth-decoupling. Two new pull requests were opened, one to remove an unused address and another to fix OPCM V2 Registry support.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request [#1304](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1304) was opened to remove an unused `op_contracts_manager_addr` from `sepolia-devnet-2`.
- Another pull request [#1303](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1303) was opened to fix `op-deployer 0.7.1` and add `OPCM V2 Registry` support.

## CLOSED ISSUES

## NEW ISSUES

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Addressing `opgeth-decoupling` Fork Tools
Issue [#21746](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21746), concerning the `opgeth-decoupling` check-* fork tools, was closed today. The latest comment confirms its completion with [#22163](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/22163). Previously, an update on July 31st noted that `check-derivation` was deleted in [#22164](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/22164), resolving a scope-addition item.

### Investigating Flaky Test `TestInteropHappyTx`
The flaky test `TestInteropHappyTx` in issue [#21940](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21940) saw a new occurrence today. The test failed in `memory-all-opn-op-reth-prague` on develop, with the error `failed to deploy EventLogger: operation failed permanently after 5 attempts: not found`. Analysis suggests that both chains' sequencer actions starved for 10-12 seconds, preventing the deploy transaction from being included. This behavior is consistent with the `op-node` driver event-loop starvation fingerprint identified in [#21952](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21952).
